declared_by: student (product judgment), 2026-10-20, after reading the memo-v4 output
rule: Ads and Premium-only features are how the free tier earns revenue. Complaints about them are complaints about the business model, not defects: removing the cause would cost revenue. Work on them should make them less disruptive within the business model (e.g. ad frequency, timing, loudness, relevance), not remove them. Defects (crashes, playback stops, sign-in failures) carry no such trade-off.

monetization_lever_issues.USB-01: ads in free listening (frequency, timing, loudness)
monetization_lever_issues.USB-02: ads inserted in podcasts for Premium subscribers
monetization_lever_issues.BIL-01: free-tier limits on choosing specific songs
monetization_lever_issues.OTH-03: ad load and Premium requirements in general

not_tagged.BIL-99: catch-all that mixes price complaints with billing errors; it cannot be split without re-labelling, so it is left untagged
not_tagged.USB-04: shuffle/autoplay complaints mix free-tier forced shuffle with genuine misbehaviour
not_tagged.PLB-05: wrong song or queue behaviour is mostly a defect, though some may be free-tier shuffle

note: Issue IDs refer to the saved catalog (out/full/issues_catalog.json). If grouping is re-run and the catalog changes, this list must be re-declared. The baseline ranking is unchanged by this lens; it only adds context for the memo.
